title: Browser Agent Completion Gate
dek: Parallax is a browser agent I built in Python: it plans a task, then clicks and types through websites to carry it out. This page rebuilds its executor on a synthetic booking app and adds a completion gate, a check that calls a task done only when the saved record proves it.
summary: Six attempts at one booking: the success notice claims three, my earlier agent’s check accepts five, and only one saved the booking asked for.
